issue_title: [Bug] Todo.__repr__ does not escape newlines in text, causing multiline output
summary: Added comprehensive regression tests for Todo.__repr__ control character escaping. The existing implementation already correctly escapes newlines, tabs, and carriage returns via Python's !r format specifier. Added three new tests with explicit assertions to prevent regression.

verify_commands.ruff_check: uv run ruff check tests/test_issue_2087_todo_repr.py src/flywheel/todo.py
